subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes aims to empower adolescent girls?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kishori Shakti Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishori Shakti Yojana (KSY)** is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** under the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)**.
 
• The scheme primarily focuses on empowering **adolescent girls** between the age group of **11 to 18 years**.
 
• The main aim is to improve the nutritional and health status of adolescent girls and encourage them to complete their education.
 
• It also seeks to enhance their self-development and empowerment by providing them with life skills and vocational training.
 
• The scheme emphasizes spreading awareness about **health, hygiene, and family welfare** among adolescent girls.
 
• Another key component of the scheme is promoting **literacy and skill development** among girls.
 
• The program is implemented through the **Anganwadi Centers** across India.
 
• By enabling girls to become self-reliant and confident, the scheme aims to create a foundation for addressing gender disparities in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **NRHM (National Rural Health Mission)**__

 __
 
• The **National Rural Health Mission (NRHM)** was launched in **2005** by the **Government of India** to address the health needs of rural areas.
 
• It aims to provide accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare to rural populations, with a special focus on vulnerable groups.
 
• The program emphasizes reducing infant and maternal mortality rates and controlling communicable and non-communicable diseases.
 
 
 
• **National Nutrition Mission**__
 __
 
• The **National Nutrition Mission**, also known as **POSHAN Abhiyaan**, was launched in **2018** by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development**.
 
• Its primary goal is to reduce the level of **stunting, undernutrition, anemia, and low birth weight in children** along with addressing malnutrition among women and adolescent girls.
 
• The mission uses technology-based real-time monitoring and focuses on convergence among various programs to improve nutritional outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)**__
 
 
• The **Janani Suraksha Yojana** is a safe motherhood intervention under the **NRHM**, launched in **2005**.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women.
 
• It provides **cash incentives** to pregnant women for delivering in government or accredited private health facilities.
